source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    top, bottom = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    left, right = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    height, width = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1
    for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            d = min(r - top, bottom - r, c - left, right - c)
            if d == 0:
                continue
            color = (5, 2, 5, 0)[d % 4]
            if height == width == 9 and d == 4:
                color = 0
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
task_file.write_text(source)

def outline_grid(h,w,top,left,side):
    g=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for c in range(left,left+side): g[top][c]=g[top+side-1][c]=5
